title: Sonic the Hedgehog - Scrap Brain Zone
description:
The final stage theme from Sonic the Hedgehog, with an indescribable emotion to it, though one that ultimately just makes me think of McDonald's. Probably fits factory and endgame levels the best.

[29 May 2023] Update: Stopped being lazy after 2 years and fixed the bass error, which was literally one command. (And also adjusted one volume.)
